1.st_exit_condition: Exit immediately if candle closes back across the Breaker Block boundary
1.invalidation: H1 Candle body closes inside the opposing breaker block

2.st_exit_condition: Target is the Daily chart major liquidity pool; exit when reached
2.invalidation: Price closes beyond the 50% midpoint of the Daily Order Block

3.sl_desc: London Killzone FVG Middle Candle Extreme (-2.0p buffer)
3.st_exit_condition: Target is the 50% Equilibrium retest of London Killzone FVG
3.invalidation: Candle closes outside the London FVG range

8.sl_desc: Below 8 EMA Demand Zone Boundary (-2.0p buffer)

9.sl_desc: Beyond Recent Swing High/Low Structure (-2.0p buffer)
